national.title: Indonesia-UEA Sepakat Kembangkan Restorasi Mangrove Pakai AI di Demak

international.title: Ex-Tory defectors barred from shaping Reform’s immigration policy, says Zia Yusuf
international.summary: Comments by Reform’s home affairs spokesperson raise questions about unity at top of the party Former Conservative defectors to Reform UK have been barred from shaping the party’s immigration policy, its home affairs spokesperson has claimed, excluding in effect the majority of the party’s MPs. “If you are in the category of being concerned about [former Conservatives being involved in Reform], none of the above are going to be involved in immigration policy or borders policy,” Zia Yusuf told a podcast by the Spectator magazine.
